APPEARANCE FOR PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR ORDER CONTINUING JUDICIAL ARBITRATION IS HEARD THIS DAY. AFTER ARGUMENT OF RESPECTIVE COUNSEL COURT ORDERED MOTION GRANTED. THE ARBITRATOR'S JURISDICTION IS EXTENDED TO 8/1/2003. THE ARBITRATION ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE IS ORDERED RE-SET TO 9/18/2003 AT 1:30 PM, IN DEPARTMENT 212. MOTION TO RE-OPEN DISCOVERY IS DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO BRING MOTION IN THE DISCOVERY DEPARTMENT. DISCOVERY REMAINS CLOSED. COURT ORDERED PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL TO SERVE ARBITRATION BRIEF NO LATER THAN 14 DAYS BEFORE THE ARBITRATION HEARING. PREVAILING PARTY TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER FOR THE COURT SIGNATURE. PROCEEDINGS REPORTED BY: HELEN SOREP-MATLEY. (212)
